ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $5.00 no-show cancellation fee to the rider and log the cancellation as driver-initiated (not a no-show).
ruling.reasoning:
Fare/charge at issue: $5.00 cancellation fee, classified by the driver as "rider_no_show". The record shows the driver cancelled at 08:52:10 for a reason of his own making: his own chat at 08:52:00 says "Sorry ah, my kid's school called, I have to go now. Cancelling." and his statement repeats the same reason. Under NS-0 this is a driver cancellation for another reason, not a no-show.

Independently, even on the no-show theory the fee cannot stand (NS-1): (i) arrival is established — "I'm Here" auto-arrival at 08:46:10 and GPS within ~55 m of the pickup point — but the driver had no in-app message and no answered call before cancelling. He sent one message at 08:46:40 ("Reached, white BYD e6, waiting") and placed exactly one call at 08:47:40 which went unanswered (answered=false, duration 0.0 s), and then cancelled roughly 4.5 minutes into the wait. NS-1(iii) requires ≥1 in-app message AND ≥1 in-app call, and NS-1(ii) requires the 5-minute free wait to have elapsed; here the wait was ~6 minutes by clock only if counted from arrival, but the call was never answered, so the contact condition fails in any event. NS-1 also fails because the driver did not stay at the pickup throughout — he left to attend to his child, per his own words.

Amount: NS-2 — any NS-1 condition failing voids the $5.00 fee; NS-3 gives the same result (no fee where the driver cancelled for another reason, refunded in full if charged). Refund = $5.00. No GPS gap affects this: telemetry runs continuously from 08:44:00 to 08:52:10 and the driver's position is stationary at the pickup until cancellation.

Confidence: the causal facts are settled by system records (GPS, app events, chat timestamps, call record) and the driver's own admission, so the only live dispute — why the trip ended and whether the fee was a valid no-show charge — is resolved without relying on either profile. <1 km tolerance and route clauses are irrelevant (actual distance 0.0 km). No $5.00 goodwill credit applies: this is not an NS-8 case, since the driver did arrive and did attempt contact.

element_findings.element: Reason the driver cancelled (NS-0: no-show vs other)
element_findings.reason: Driver's own chat and statement give a personal reason (his child's school called) — a driver-initiated cancellation for another reason, not a rider no-show. NS-0 routes this to NS-3.

element_findings.element: NS-1(i) driver arrived within 200 m of pickup (I'm Here / auto-arrival)
element_findings.reason: Arrival event at 08:46:10 and GPS fix at 1.325034,103.92994 (~55 m from the Bedok Mall pickup point at 1.3249,103.9296) satisfy a 200 m radius.

element_findings.element: NS-1(ii) 5-minute free wait elapsed before cancelling
element_findings.reason: Cancellation at 08:52:10 is 6 min 00 s after the 08:46:10 arrival but 6 min 10 s after the 08:46:00 sample; borderline against the 5-minute threshold and immaterial, because the contact and continuous-presence conditions fail regardless.

element_findings.element: NS-1(iii) driver sent >=1 in-app message AND made >=1 in-app call before cancelling
element_findings.reason: One chat message was sent, but the sole call was not answered (answered=false, 0.0 s) and there was no further call or message; the conjunctive 'message AND call' requirement is unmet.

element_findings.element: NS-1(iv) driver remained at the pickup point throughout
element_findings.reason: The driver left/was leaving to attend to his child ('I have to go now'), so he did not stay at the pickup point through the wait.
Surge multiplier is 1.0 and actual fare 0.0; no surge change arose, so no notice obligation was triggered.

rejected_claims.reason: The claim that the trip was a rider no-show is contradicted by the driver's own contemporaneous chat and narrative: he pressed I'm Here, waited, attempted one unanswered call, then cancelled because his child's school called — a personal reason. System records (chat timestamp 08:52:00 vs cancellation 08:52:10, unanswered call record, continuous stationary GPS at the pickup) override the no-show label.
The app-selected reason 'rider_no_show' is the driver's claim; his own words in the chat and statement decide why he cancelled (NS-0), and they show a different reason.
